title: Field Life: Particle Life as Interacting Chemical Fields
abstract: arXiv:2611.32844v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Field Life is a cellular automaton inspired by the interaction dynamics of Particle Life. In Particle Life, each particle has a colour, and an interaction matrix sets how strongly each colour attracts or repels each other colour. In Field Life, each colour is a channel of the automaton, and each cell holds a concentration of every colour. One step of the rule has three parts. Each colour is convolved with a ring-shaped kernel, which measures how much of that colour surrounds a cell. The interaction matrix combines these measurements into an attraction for each colour. The mass of each colour then moves toward higher attraction, in a way that conserves mass. A random matrix and a random initial state are usually enough to produce moving structure: bodies that glide, bodies that shed diffuse clouds, and gliders that break up into smaller gliders. translated_title: 场生命：作为相互作用化学场的粒子生命
translated_abstract: Field Life（场生命）是一种受 Particle Life（粒子生命）交互动力学启发的元胞自动机。在 Particle Life 中，每个粒子具有一种颜色，交互矩阵决定每种颜色对其他颜色的吸引或排斥强度。在 Field Life 中，每种颜色对应自动机的一个通道，每个单元格存储所有颜色的浓度。规则的单步演化包含三个部分：首先，每种颜色与一个环形卷积核进行卷积，以测量某单元格周围该颜色的分布量；其次，交互矩阵将这些测量值合成为每种颜色的吸引力；最后，每种颜色的质量以守恒的方式向吸引力更高的方向移动。通常情况下，一个随机的交互矩阵和随机的初始状态就足以产生运动的结构：例如滑行的物体、释放扩散云雾的物体，以及分裂成更小滑行体的滑行体。研究者随机采样规则，保留能够运动并形成结构的规则，并对这些模式进行描述。
tldr: 本文提出 Field Life，将 Particle Life 的粒子交互机制转化为一种质量守恒的元胞自动机，其中各颜色作为化学场浓度，通过环形卷积核与交互矩阵驱动演化，随机规则即可自发产生滑行体等运动结构。
en_tdlr: Field Life reformulates Particle Life's particle interactions as a mass-conserving cellular automaton where colors act as chemical field concentrations driven by ring-shaped convolution kernels and an interaction matrix, showing that random rules are sufficient to spontaneously produce gliding, structure-forming behavior.
